thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging @sre-oncall — latency spike + 5xxs on /v1/embeddings route (region: us-west-2). Auto-alert: >30% error rate over 2m.

sre-oncall: saw it, joining. can someone paste top customers on that route?

emma: AcmeBooks and Streamly are the top two tenants right now, AcmeBooks at ~35% of qps on embeddings-prod.

raj: quick note — rerank route also seeing backpressure but much lower qps. suspect embeddings hot-route causing queueing and spilling into shared workers.

marta: confirming traces — KV cache growth and long tail on seq_len=2048. requests that include rerank sometimes trigger extra passes.

ops-lead: immediate mitigation options: 1) reduce per-endpoint qps for embeddings, 2) carve out dedicated slice for AcmeBooks, 3) disable rerank for impacted customers. prefer surgical carve first.

emma: I can do a soft-per-endpoint cap: bump embeddings global limit down 30% and carve AcmeBooks a separate quota slice (reserve 20% of existing cap) — will buy headroom.

raj: sounds good. timeline? I can apply carve and monitor. command: `redwoodctl routes adjust --route embeddings --set-global-qps 7000` (current global 10000) then `redwoodctl routes carve --route embeddings --tenant AcmeBooks --qps 2000`

marta: +1, while you do that toggle rerank off for AcmeBooks to reduce multi-model churn: `redwoodctl tenant update AcmeBooks --features rerank=false` (config change propagates within ~30s).

sre-oncall: perform changes now. tagging followups in incident channel.

incident-bot: action initiated by sre-oncall at 1717504380 — runbooks: per-route-sculpt > surgical-carve.

emma: applied global cap to 7000, carving AcmeBooks 2000 slice now. monitoring telemetry.

raj: applied rerank disable for AcmeBooks. note: Streamly still heavy but below carve threshold.

marta: latency down ~40% on embeddings p50/p95, error rate falling to ~8% within 90s.

ops-lead: good. next step: tighten per-tenant quotas for anonymous/unknown tenants to prevent noisy neighbors — temporarily set default tenant qps to 50.

emma: done. `redwoodctl tenants set-default-qps --qps 50`

raj: customers impacted: AcmeBooks had temporary rerank disabled (prod), we should notify SRE/CS to email them with explanation and ETA on rerank re-enable. Streamly unaffected.

sre-oncall: creating incident ticket INC-2026-1720 with mitigation, RCA pointer, and action items: model-quantize followup, KV cache eviction tuning, and per-route autoscale thresholds.

incident-bot: incident severity updated to SEV-2 (customer impact: some degraded embeddings for AcmeBooks). Notifying oncall rotation handoff in 30m.

emma: planning to gradually restore rerank for AcmeBooks after 2 hours of stable metrics; will do canary at 10% then 50% then 100%.

ops-lead: make sure to create postmortem template with timeline and exact `redwoodctl` commands executed. Also add customer comms draft.

raj: rolling back temporary global cap in 2 hours if stable, otherwise escalate to infra for dedicated pool request.

marta: logs for today saved at s3://redwood-incidents/1717504321/ — include traces and top-K tenant breakdown.

sre-oncall: handoff note for next oncall: monitor embeddings error rate, p95 latency, and queue depth; key commands in runbook: `routes adjust`, `tenants set-default-qps`, `tenant update` (feature toggles).

emma: thanks — will follow up with post-incident thread once stable. :thumbsup:
